bug_summary.issue: 400 Bad Request error when uploading vendor documents
bug_summary.root_cause: Document type mismatch between frontend form values and backend validation
bug_summary.user_impact: Complete blocking of document upload functionality

root_cause_analysis.error_message: Invalid document type. Must be one of: W9, W8, 1099, contract, insurance, certification, license, pricing_sheet, other

prevention_measures: Added comments in all frontend files referencing backend validation
Centralized document type definitions in vendorConfig.js
Documented expected values in service layer JSDoc comments

next_action: Ready for user testing - document upload functionality fully restored
notes: This was a critical bug that completely blocked document upload functionality. The issue was caused by inconsistent document type values between frontend and backend. All frontend references have been updated to match the backend validation requirements. No backend changes were needed as the validation logic was correct.
